text:
maria-partners: Partner request: lightweight marketplace starter that demonstrates k8s inference, autoscaler toggle, and a private VPC example. They want cross-cloud examples (AWS/GCP) and a 1-page runbook. Can we scope this to a single repo with modules/ + examples/?

eli-eng: Sounds good. Recommend modules: network, cluster, inference, kms. No provider {} inside modules. Examples at examples/aws and examples/gcp. Add a tiny demo that uses a single-node cluster for quick smoke tests.

viv-arch: Architectural constraints: support routing_mode (hosted|dedicated), optional enable_hsm, and firewall_profiles. For private deployments include instructions to set up VPC peering or private endpoints. I'll drop a concise diagram in docs/arch.md.

Dave-terraform: I'll own module scaffolding. Checklist: each module has variables.tf, outputs.tf, README.md with a minimal usage example. Outputs should include cluster_endpoint, kubeconfig_raw, network_id. Top-level example snippet I'll include:

```
module "network" {
  source = "../modules/network"
  name   = "mp-net"
  region = var.region
}
module "cluster" {
  source     = "../modules/cluster"
  network_id = module.network.id
  cluster_name = "mp-demo"
}
module "inference" {
  source       = "../modules/inference"
  cluster_name = module.cluster.name
  routing_mode = var.routing_mode
  enable_hsm   = var.enable_hsm
}
```

review-bot: CI template created: https://ci.internal/redwood/marketplace-starter (tfsec + terratest + sbom) :white_check_mark:

maria-partners: Excellent. Timeline: Dave PR with scaffolding by EOD Wed, Viv to add arch + security checklist, Eli to add example cost estimate and quick deploy steps. We'll do partner walkthrough next Tue. Action items noted. :calendar:
